title: Reader Chapter 15
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

breakdown.fullRead: Title: Training Room Restart Scenario: The Zappos trainer closes the Zappos training binder, then stops before the usual applause. New hires are still in their seats, name tags curled at the corners. She restarts the ending with the $1,000 offer: take the money and leave, or stay after training by choice. The old routine would have let everyone drift into day one. What to do: The Zappos trainer pauses the sendoff and states the offer as a real fork. She gives the room a quiet minute before anyone signs the final form.
